tb21_profile.skill: Implement a CPU emulator from an ISA spec: parse an ELF, decode/execute instructions with exact integer/bit semantics, and emulate the Linux syscall ABI for file I/O well enough to boot a real program.
tb21_profile.domain: Low-level systems in JavaScript/Node: MIPS ISA, ELF32 loading, syscall ABI, byte-level memory, framebuffer output.
tb21_profile.task_form: Implement-from-spec, large and multi-step, verified by running a real third-party binary (doomgeneric) and checking the first rendered frame.

verifier_notes: Checked nothing against its tests here beyond the grades. Two TerminalWorld picks (tw_134335, tw_362046) are FREE and are ranked only inside per_source; tw_134335 is TerminalWorld's single best skill match (ESIL emulation with a scripted interrupt handler) and it being FREE is the honest reason TerminalWorld contributes nothing to final_top10. All Recursive-Task-Synthesis entries are 'absent' by construction; graded equivalents existed elsewhere so none were promoted.

notes: CalibForge is overwhelmingly the best pool here and it is not close: it contains near-duplicates of this TB2.1 task (RISC-V/WASM/CHIP-8 interpreters written in JS, run with `node x.js`, loading an ELF and emulating syscalls), several graded strong. Eight of the final ten are CalibForge; the other two are the only TMax entries that genuinely make the model author a decode-execute loop. Terminal-Lego-15k is the weakest corpus for this task - it has no emulator tasks at all, so ranks 4-10 there are parser/endianness/bitwise filler with overall<=3 and should not be trusted as real transfer. TerminalWorld's best match (tw_134335, ESIL emulation) is FREE and therefore excluded from final_top10 per the hard rule. Recursive-Task-Synthesis's only defensible offering is its ARM64 hand-assembly cluster (syscall ABI, register conventions) - useful ISA knowledge, wrong task genre, and all 'absent'. SWE-Rebench's pfp cluster (an interpreter for 010-editor binary templates) is a surprisingly good skill match for a SWE-issue corpus and is repo-tests graded; merge should not discount it just because task_form is 2.
